vectors.name: second-offer
vectors.description: The earlier first-block marker claims the body, so the next offer is refused.

vectors.name: blank-stop
vectors.description: A blank line refuses a lone marker.

vectors.name: nested-quote
vectors.description: A refused marker inside a nested quote reports its source column.

vectors.name: accepted
vectors.description: A marker that attaches the next block is quiet.

vectors.name: not-an-offer
vectors.description: A document-level plus read as ordinary text is quiet.

vectors.name: suppressed-line
vectors.description: A line directive suppresses the refused marker on its own line.
